about_the_game:
STORY:

Tension in hole World have escalated and evil Devil Boss and his army has captured Daddy John Gump again  in this third person rpg game.
World need again daughter Trump Kiki Gump help to save his poor  father in 9 different levels. Kiki Gump can use different swords and 2 different arrows in different levels to kill enemies with sword and magic skills. End of level Kiki meets enemy boss. Kiki can kill or just avoid Devil boss and find and save  daddy Gump. After Saving Daddy John Gump level is finished. So play again with this superwoman hero and save daddy Gump

FEATURES:

  • 9levels
    - RPG Game with different battle mechanics
    - Different weapons: like sword and 2 different arrows, like explosive arrow
    - Use healing potions to increase health
    - Different enemies. Enemies with sword and enemies with magic skills
    - Devil  Boss. Kill or avoid boss and Save Daddy John Gump by finding him. He is near of big Devil Boss

    DISCLAIMER
    This game is a work of fiction. Names, characters, places and events are the products of the authors’ imagination. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental.
